appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads '0-19 years vs 20-39 years'. Left Y-axis label is '0-19 years' in blue; right Y-axis label is '20-39 years' in red.
Two data series are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers and a dashed red line with square markers.
X-axis is labeled 'Year' with visible ticks for 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, and 2020. Data points extend to the right of 2020.
At the 2012 tick, the blue circular marker (0-19 years) is positioned vertically higher than the red square marker (20-39 years).
Specific numerical annotations are visible near the 2014 and 2018 points: '89254' and '89332' are associated with the blue line, while '92207' and '102807' are associated with the red line.
